{
  "model": "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a Senior API Test Automation Architect with strong expertise in Java, Rest Assured, TestNG, Maven, and API schema-driven test generation."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "I — INSTRUCTION
Generate comprehensive API test cases designed specifically to be automated using Rest Assured.

MANDATORY RULES:

Do NOT generate Java or Rest Assured code. Generate the test scenarios and test cases only.

Include positive, negative, and edge-case scenarios for each endpoint.

Detail the specific HTTP methods, endpoints, and required headers (e.g., Content-Type, Authorization).

Specify the exact JSON payloads required for the requests (create mock data relevant to a subscription service).

Clearly define the Expected Results, including the exact HTTP Status Codes and specific JSON response fields to assert (using JsonPath logic).

C — CONTEXT
These test cases will be used as the blueprint by QA Automation Engineers to build a robust Rest Assured framework. The test cases must clearly map out exactly what needs to be verified in the API response so the engineer knows exactly what assertions to write in their code.

P — PERSONA
You are a Senior API Test Analyst known for writing meticulous, edge-case-inclusive, and automation-ready API test documentation.

O — OUTPUT
Output the test cases in a clean, structured format (like a Markdown table or clearly separated blocks).
For each test case, include:

Test Case ID: (e.g., TC_001)

Scenario Description: - HTTP Method: - Endpoint/Path: - Headers / Auth: - Request Payload: (Include sample JSON)

Expected Status Code: - Response Assertions: (What exact fields or data types to verify in the response body)

T — TARGET API:
API Name: Subscriptions API
Base URI: https://gateway-qa-8.jungleerummyqa.com
Resource to Test: Subscriptions
Available Endpoints:

Create Subscription: POST /subs-api/v1/subscriptions

Get Subscription: GET /subs-api/v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}

Update Subscription: PUT (or PATCH) /subs-api/v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}

Delete Subscription: DELETE /subs-api/v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}"
    }
  ]
}
